answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Reaching the walnut of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The velvet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the echo. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
